in_hebrew.name: Seward
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Brave or secure
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Seward הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old English ‘sigeweard’, meaning ‘victory-worthy’. Seward has been a popular name for boys in the English-speaking world due to its strong and courageous meaning.

in_greek.name: Seward
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Brave or secure
in_greek.long_meaning: Seward είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from Old English ‘sigeweard’, meaning ‘victory-worthy’. Seward has been a popular name for boys in the English-speaking world due to its strong and courageous meaning.

in_latin.name: Seward
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Brave or secure
in_latin.long_meaning: Seward est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from Old English ‘sigeweard’, meaning ‘victory-worthy’. Seward has been a popular name for boys in the English-speaking world due to its strong and courageous meaning.
